# Refresh the EWS credential snapshot before deciding whether to retry

The owned EWS client handles an authentication failure, reloads provider credentials and replaces its RefCell snapshot before RETRY or ABORT is selected. A new password therefore reaches later requests instead of reusing the old copied Basic password. Provider access and interactive error handling both belong to the attached server interface, so outgoing AuthenticationProvider moves to nsIMsgOutgoingServer and generic operation bounds require both traits. With no password, the patch prompts directly rather than first asking whether to retry a failed password. This does not repair outgoing failure UX or prove a successful retry. Current shared code later distinguishes prompt cancellation as ABORT and uses protocol_shared/Necko rather than the historical Credentials architecture. No test was added or run in this patch.

Scope: rust/ews_xpcom.
